questions.question: Which dimension considers data security and privacy?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Information and technology". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.36 (Chapter 3 – The four dimensions of service management).

textbook_references.chapter: Chapter 3 – The four dimensions of service management

questions.question: Which term relates to service levels aligned with the needs of service consumers?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Warranty". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.208 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which directly assists with the diagnosis and resolution of simple incidents?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: A — "Scripts for collecting user information". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.133 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: What are guiding principles?

options.A: A set of interconnected activities that help an organization deliver a valuable service
options.B: A description of one or more services that help address the needs of a target consumer group
options.C: A set of specialized organizational capabilities for enabling value for customers
options.D: Recommendations that help an organization when adopting a service management approach

questions.explanation: Correct answer: D — "Recommendations that help an organization when adopting a service management approach". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.198 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which approach is CORRECT when applying the guiding principle 'keep it simple and practical'?

options.A: Only add controls and metrics when they are needed
options.B: Design controls and metrics first, then remove those not adding value
options.C: Design controls and metrics and add them individually until all are implemented
options.D: Only add controls and metrics that are required for compliance

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Design controls and metrics first, then remove those not adding value". This is supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.66 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: What is the purpose of the 'problem management' practice?

options.A: To protect the information needed by the organization to conduct its business
options.B: To reduce the likelihood and impact of incidents by identifying actual and potential causes of incidents, and managing workarounds and known errors
options.C: To align the organization's practices and services with changing business needs through the ongoing identification and improvement of services
options.D: To minimize the negative impact of incidents by restoring normal service operation as quickly as possible

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "To reduce the likelihood and impact of incidents by identifying actual and potential causes of incidents, and managing workarounds and known errors". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.140 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which practice forms a link between the service provider and the users of services?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: D — "Service desk". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.204 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which is a purpose of release management?

options.C: To make new and changed services available for use
options.D: To move hardware and software to live environments

questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "To make new and changed services available for use". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.144 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: What is recommended by the guiding principle 'progress iteratively with feedback'?

options.A: A current state assessment that is carried out at the start of an improvement initiative
options.B: The identification of all interested parts at the start of an improvement initiative
options.C: An improvement initiative that is broken into a number of manageable sections
options.D: An assessment of how all the parts of an organization will affect an improvement initiative

questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "An improvement initiative that is broken into a number of manageable sections". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.57 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: Which guiding principle considers customer and user experience?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Focus on value". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.49 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: Which statement about the 'change enablement' practice is CORRECT?

options.A: Service requests are usually normal changes that can be implemented quickly without authorization
options.B: Emergency changes are changes that must be fully tested and fully documented prior to implementation
options.C: Standard changes are changes that need to be scheduled, assessed and authorized following a standard process
options.D: Emergency changes are changes that must be implemented as soon as possible and therefore authorization is expedited

questions.explanation: Correct answer: D — "Emergency changes are changes that must be implemented as soon as possible and therefore authorization is expedited". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.129 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which is a key activity carried out in the 'did we get there?' step of the 'continual improvement' model?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: D — "Evaluate measurements and metrics". This is supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.81 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: What can a service remove from the consumer and impose on the consumer?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "Cost". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.28 (Chapter 2 – Key concepts of service management).

textbook_references.chapter: Chapter 2 – Key concepts of service management

questions.question: What does 'change enablement' PRIMARILY focus on?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Changes to products and services". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.177 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which is handled as a service request?

options.A: An investigation to identify the cause of an incident
options.B: A compliment about an IT support team
options.C: The failure of an IT service
options.D: An emergency change to implement a security patch

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "A compliment about an IT support team". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.207 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which is a key requirement for a successful service level agreement (SLA)?

options.A: Using individual metrics that relate to the service catalogue
options.B: Using bundled metrics to relate performance to outcomes
options.C: Using single-system-based metrics that relate to outputs
options.D: Using an agreement between the service provider and service supplier

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Using bundled metrics to relate performance to outcomes". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.205 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which is considered by the 'partners and suppliers' dimension?

options.D: Working with an integrator to manage relationships

questions.explanation: Correct answer: D — "Working with an integrator to manage relationships". This is supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.117 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which practice recommends using tools for collaboration and the automated matching of symptoms?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "Incident management". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.132 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which practice would help a user gain access to an application that they need to use?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "Service request management". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.167 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: What is used to link activities within the service value chain?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Inputs, outputs and triggers". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.68 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: Which TWO practices use workarounds?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "Problem management and incident management". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.39 (Chapter 3 – The four dimensions of service management).

textbook_references.chapter: Chapter 3 – The four dimensions of service management

questions.question: Which is included in the purpose of the 'deliver and support' value chain activity?

options.A: Meeting stakeholder expectations for time to market

questions.explanation: Correct answer: D — "Providing services to agreed specifications". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.75 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: Which are elements of the service value system?

options.A: Service provision, service consumption, service relationship management

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Governance, service value chain, practices". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.46 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: What is an incident?

options.A: The planned removal of an item that might affect a service
options.B: A result enabled by one or more outputs
options.C: A possible future event that could cause harm
options.D: A service interruption resolved by the use of self-help tools

questions.explanation: Correct answer: D — "A service interruption resolved by the use of self-help tools". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.132 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: What is defined as a change of state that has significance for the management of an IT service?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: A — "Event". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.196 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which dimension includes the knowledge needed for the management of services?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Information and technology". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.36 (Chapter 3 – The four dimensions of service management).

textbook_references.chapter: Chapter 3 – The four dimensions of service management

questions.question: What is the PRIMARY use of a change schedule?

options.A: To support the 'incident management' practice and improvement planning
options.C: To plan changes and help avoid conflicts

questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "To plan changes and help avoid conflicts". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.130 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which guiding principle focuses on reducing costs and human errors?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "Optimize and automate". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.65 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: Which guiding principle helps to ensure that each improvement effort has more focus and is easier to maintain?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "Progress iteratively with feedback". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.57 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: Which is a key activity carried out in the 'did we get there?' step of the 'continual improvement' model?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: D — "Evaluate measurements and metrics". This is supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.81 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: What is important for a 'continual improvement register' (CIR)?

options.A: Improvement ideas are documented, assessed and prioritized
options.B: Improvement ideas from many sources are kept in a single CIR
options.C: Improvement ideas that are not being actioned immediately are removed from the CIR
options.D: Improvement ideas are tested, funded and agreed

questions.explanation: Correct answer: A — "Improvement ideas are documented, assessed and prioritized". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.92 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which is a purpose of the 'service level management' practice?

options.A: To establish and nurture the links between the organization and its stakeholders
options.B: To ensure that the organization's suppliers and their performance are managed appropriately
options.C: To support the agreed quality of a service by handling all agreed, user-initiated service requests
options.D: To set clear business-based targets for service levels

questions.explanation: Correct answer: D — "To set clear business-based targets for service levels". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.162 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: What describes the steps needed to create and deliver a specific service to a consumer?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "A value stream". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.42 (Chapter 3 – The four dimensions of service management).

textbook_references.chapter: Chapter 3 – The four dimensions of service management

questions.question: Which helps to manage an incident when it is unclear which support team should be working on the incident?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Swarming". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.132 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which statement about the 'continual improvement' practice is CORRECT?

options.A: Continual improvement participation should be limited to a small dedicated team
options.B: It is the role of senior management to authorize improvement initiatives
options.C: Training should be provided to those involved in continual improvement
options.D: A single continual improvement register should be maintained by senior management

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "It is the role of senior management to authorize improvement initiatives". This is supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.93 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which does the ITIL service value system discourage?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Organizational silos". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.47 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: An SLA is a service level agreement. Which describes the 'watermelon SLA' effect?

options.A: A single SLA defines target service levels for multiple customers, so every customer sees reports about other customers' experiences
options.B: The metrics in an SLA are focused on internal measures, so that reports show everything is good, while the customer is not satisfied
options.C: SLA targets change very frequently, so that each report includes new measures and trends cannot be analyzed
options.D: Introducing SLAs for a service enables customers to see that the service provider is doing a really good job, so this improves satisfaction

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "The metrics in an SLA are focused on internal measures, so that reports show everything is good, while the customer is not satisfied". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.205 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which practice includes conducting regular reviews to ensure that services are still appropriate and relevant?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: A — "Service level management". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.165 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: What is a service?

options.A: A possible event that could cause harm or loss, or make it more difficult to achieve objectives
options.B: A means of enabling value co-creation by facilitating outcomes that customers want to achieve, without the customer having to manage specific costs and risks
options.C: A tangible or intangible deliverable of an activity
options.D: Joint activities performed by a service provider and a service consumer to ensure continual value co-creation based on agreed and available service offerings

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "A means of enabling value co-creation by facilitating outcomes that customers want to achieve, without the customer having to manage specific costs and risks". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.204 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which TWO are important aspects of the 'service request management' practice? 1. Standardization and automation 2. Providing a variety of channels for access 3. Establishing a shared view of targets 4. Policies for approvals
questions.explanation: Correct answer: D — "1 and 4". This is supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.160 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: What is required by all service desk staff?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "Demonstration of emotional intelligence". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.161 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which practice establishes a channel between the service provider and its users?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: D — "Service desk". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.204 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which practice includes the use of approaches such as Lean, Agile and DevOps with the aim of facilitating a greater amount of change at a quicker rate?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: D — "Continual improvement". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.93 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which practice has a purpose that includes maximizing success by ensuring that risks have been properly assessed?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Change enablement". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.128 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which practice provides users with a way to get various requests arranged, explained and coordinated?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: D — "Service desk". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.159 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which helps to streamline the fulfilment of service requests?

options.A: Understanding which service requests can be accomplished with limited approvals
options.B: Creating new workflows for every service request
options.C: Separating requests relating to service failures from the degradation of services
options.D: Eliminating service requests which have complex workflows

questions.explanation: Correct answer: A — "Understanding which service requests can be accomplished with limited approvals". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.166 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which statement about outcomes is CORRECT?

options.A: They are deliverables provided to service consumers
options.B: They allow service consumers to achieve a desired result
options.C: They provide products to service providers based on outputs
options.D: They co-create value for service providers by reducing costs and risks

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "They allow service consumers to achieve a desired result". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.26 (Chapter 2 – Key concepts of service management).

textbook_references.chapter: Chapter 2 – Key concepts of service management

questions.question: Which guiding principle says that services and processes should NOT provide a solution for every exception?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: A — "Keep it simple and practical". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.63 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: Identify the missing word in the following sentence. The purpose of the 'supplier management' practice is to ensure that the organization’s suppliers and their performances are [?] appropriately to support the seamless provision of quality products and services.
questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "managed". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.115 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Identify the missing words in the following sentence. The purpose of the service configuration management practice is to ensure that accurate and reliable information about the [?], and the CIs that support them, is available when and where it is needed.
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "configuration of services". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.204 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which practice requires skills and competencies related to business analysis, supplier management and relationship management?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "Service level management". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.162 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: When should a workaround be created?

options.A: As soon as possible, once the incident is logged
options.B: After the resolution of a problem
options.C: When a problem cannot be resolved quickly
options.D: When a potential permanent solution has been identified

questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "When a problem cannot be resolved quickly". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.141 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: What is a configuration item?

options.A: Any financially valuable component that can contribute to the delivery of an IT product or service
options.B: Any change of state that has significance for the management of a service
options.C: Any component that needs to be managed in order to deliver an IT service
options.D: A problem that has been analyzed but has not been resolved

questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "Any component that needs to be managed in order to deliver an IT service". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.194 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Identify the missing words in the following sentence. When an organization has decided to improve a service, it should start by considering [?].
questions.explanation: Correct answer: A — "existing information". This is supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.206 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which is a use of the change schedule?

options.B: Deciding the approval authority for changes

questions.explanation: Correct answer: A — "Assigning resources to changes". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.130 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which dimension of service management considers the workflows and controls needed to deliver services?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: D — "Value streams and processes". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.41 (Chapter 3 – The four dimensions of service management).

textbook_references.chapter: Chapter 3 – The four dimensions of service management

questions.question: Which guiding principle considers how the steps of a process can be performed as efficiently as possible?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: D — "Optimize and automate". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.65 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: Which statement about the 'incident management' practice is CORRECT?

options.A: It identifies the cause of major incidents
options.B: It authorizes changes to resolve incidents
options.C: It maintains detailed procedures for diagnosing incidents
options.D: It resolves the highest impact incidents first

questions.explanation: Correct answer: D — "It resolves the highest impact incidents first". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.197 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: How should an organization prioritize incidents?

options.A: Ask the user for their preferred resolution timeframe
options.B: Assess the availability of the appropriate support team
options.C: Use an agreed classification which is based on the business impact of the incident
options.D: Create an order of incidents based on the dates and times when they were logged

questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "Use an agreed classification which is based on the business impact of the incident". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.131 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which is a purpose of the 'relationship management' practice?

options.A: To systematically observe services and service components
options.B: To protect the information needed by the organization to conduct its business
options.C: To be the entry point and single point of contact for the service provider with all of its users
options.D: To identify, analyze, monitor, and continually improve links with stakeholders

questions.explanation: Correct answer: D — "To identify, analyze, monitor, and continually improve links with stakeholders". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.106 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which statement about problems is CORRECT?

options.A: Problems are not related to incidents
options.B: Problems must be resolved quickly in order to restore normal business activity
options.C: Problem analysis should focus on one of the four dimensions to achieve a fast diagnosis

questions.explanation: Correct answer: D — "Problem prioritization involves risk assessment". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.203 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which is a risk that might be removed from a service consumer by an IT service?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Security breach". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.28 (Chapter 2 – Key concepts of service management).

textbook_references.chapter: Chapter 2 – Key concepts of service management

questions.question: Which is one of the MAIN concerns of the 'design and transition' value chain activity?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "Meeting stakeholder expectations". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.195 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which should be handled by 'service request management'?

options.A: A request to implement a security patch
options.B: A request to provide a laptop
options.C: A request to resolve an error in a service
options.D: A request to change a target in a service level agreement

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "A request to provide a laptop". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.166 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: What can be described as an operating model for the creation and management of products and services?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Service value chain". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.67 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: Which action is performed by a service provider?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "Ensuring access to agreed resources". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.205 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which step of the continual improvement model includes baseline assessments?

options.D: Where do we want to be?

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Where are we now?". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.79 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: Which describes a 'change authority'?

options.A: A model used to determine who will assess a change
options.B: A person who approves a change
options.C: A tool used to help plan changes
options.D: A way to manage the people aspects of change

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "A person who approves a change". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.193 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which is NOT a component of the service value system?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Opportunity and demand". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.48 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: Which statement about service relationship management is CORRECT?

options.A: It focuses on the service actions performed by users
options.B: It requires the service consumer to create resources for the service provider
options.C: It requires co-operation of both the service provider and service consumer
options.D: It focuses on the fulfilment of the agreed service actions

questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "It requires co-operation of both the service provider and service consumer". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.205 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: What is the MOST important reason for prioritizing incidents?

options.A: To ensure that user expectations are realistic
options.B: To ensure that incidents with highest impact are resolved first
options.D: To provide links to related changes and known errors

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "To ensure that incidents with highest impact are resolved first". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.131 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which 'service level management' activity helps staff to deliver a more business-focused service?

options.A: Creating targets based on the percentage of uptime of a service
options.B: Understanding the ongoing requirements of customers
options.C: Using complex technical terminology in service level agreements (SLAs)

questions.explanation: Correct answer: B — "Understanding the ongoing requirements of customers". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.163 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which practice has a purpose that includes the handling of pre-defined, user-initiated demands for service?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: A — "Service request management". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.166 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which guiding principle considers which parts of an existing process should be kept by identifying how they contribute to value creation?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: D — "Keep it simple and practical". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.63 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: What is the purpose of the 'monitoring and event management' practice?

options.A: To restore normal service operation as quickly as possible
options.B: To manage workarounds and known errors
options.C: To capture demand for incident resolution and service requests
options.D: To systematically observe services and service components

questions.explanation: Correct answer: D — "To systematically observe services and service components". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.138 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which statement about outcomes is CORRECT?

options.A: Outcomes rely on outputs to deliver results for a stakeholder
options.B: Outcomes use activities to produce tangible or intangible deliverables
options.C: Outcomes give service consumers assurance of products or services
options.D: Outcomes help a service consumer to assess the cost of a specific activity

questions.explanation: Correct answer: A — "Outcomes rely on outputs to deliver results for a stakeholder". This is supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.26 (Chapter 2 – Key concepts of service management).

textbook_references.chapter: Chapter 2 – Key concepts of service management

questions.question: Which skill is required by the 'service level management' practice?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: A — "Supplier management". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.118 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).

questions.question: Which statement about the 'continual improvement model' is CORRECT?

options.A: Organizations should work through the steps of the model in the sequence in which they are presented
options.B: The flow of the model helps organizations to link improvements to its goals
options.C: The model is applicable to only certain parts of the service value system
options.D: Organizations should use an additional model or method to link improvements to customer value

questions.explanation: Correct answer: A — "Organizations should work through the steps of the model in the sequence in which they are presented". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.77 (CHAPTER 4).

questions.question: What is the definition of warranty?

options.A: A means of identifying events that could cause harm or loss
options.B: A means of determining whether a service is fit for purpose
options.C: A means of identifying a result for a stakeholder
options.D: A means of determining whether a service is fit for use

questions.explanation: Correct answer: D — "A means of determining whether a service is fit for use". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.29 (Chapter 2 – Key concepts of service management).

textbook_references.chapter: Chapter 2 – Key concepts of service management

questions.question: Which practice has a purpose that includes managing risks relating to confidentiality, integrity and availability?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: C — "Information security management". This is strongly supported by the ITIL 4 Foundation guidance on p.197 (Chapter 5 – ITIL management practices).
